future_probe_protocol.instrument: Use the delivered registry_check.py as a stable external detector; pin its digest. Do not read a changed checker from a changing baseline root.
future_probe_protocol.same_command: Keep the absolute checker path, replay-root path, cwd, arguments, environment and population bytes constant for pristine, mutant and exact-byte restoration replays. Run summary and JSON as two separate constant command vectors.
future_probe_protocol.clean_controls: A source-code mutant is scored only when its original detector passes the entire chosen witness case's expected exit/findings/projection; a deliberately red fixture can therefore be a passing detector control.
future_probe_protocol.mutant_scope: One prospective behavior-point defect per isolated checker copy; do not combine mutants or edit sibling/production code.
future_probe_protocol.recording: Retain stdout, stderr, exit code, exact argv/cwd, instrument/population/affected-input before-mutated-restored SHA-256 values and absent/present paths. Restore exact bytes and replay even after a failed command. Do not classify a pre-existing or unexplained pristine failure as a kill.
future_probe_protocol.live_S038_repair_gate: Actual baseline repair additionally requires the original source reopening and the actual frozen citing-file map; this synthetic design provides neither. If S038-only mutable-cell changes do not clean the live thirteen-row run, record the other findings instead of widening or editing the population.
